tex_content.label: ex:degree-suspension
tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Degrees of power maps and their suspensions] ↗ def:suspension ↗ cor:homology-spheres 1. ch2:2.32\group Cellular Homology

The map $z\mapsto z^k$ on $S^1$ has degree $k$, and its local degrees add to $k$. Suspension preserves degree, so suspending this map repeatedly realizes degree $k$ on every higher sphere. \end{example}
